text: High value contribution is self-amplifying in a DAO: when a member adds substantial value, other token holders want to add their skills to the same work product through a policing engagement, which focuses all members' joint efforts on the highest possible value proposition.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, DAO Fallacies (2022). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4067783
abstract: Moreover, if a DAO member adds substantial value to the DAO, other DAO token holders will want to add their skills to the same work product via a policing engagement which focuses all DAO members' joint efforts on the highest possible value proposition.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: members can observe and join high value work products
